keySentence: She followed the yellow brick road.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy saw a long road made of yellow bricks. The road went far, far away. A good witch told her to follow it. She followed the yellow brick road.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Glinda the Good Witch pointed to a winding road of golden bricks. "Follow the yellow brick road," she said with a smile. Dorothy did not know where it led, but she trusted the kind witch. She stepped onto the bright path with Toto by her side. She followed the yellow brick road all the way to the Emerald City.
facts.Word cards: followed = 따라갔다 / yellow = 노란 / brick = 벽돌 / road = 길
